concepts.description: A modular unit that encapsulates the AUV system components and architecture.
A physical or simulated robotic platform that interacts with sensors and actuators within the AUV system.
A defined boundary through which components of the AUV system communicate, exposing values and events.
A component within the AUV system responsible for processing inputs and/or producing outputs to control system behaviour.
A basic data type defined within the AUV_Module to represent fundamental values used throughout the system.
A structured data type defined within AUV_Module that aggregates multiple named fields of potentially different types.
A named data field exposed by an Interface, representing a piece of information available to system components.
A named signal or trigger defined within an Interface that system components can send or receive, optionally with parameters and a return value.
A named computational unit defined within AUV_Module that takes inputs and produces an output, encapsulating a specific operation.

instances.description: The top-level module representing the AUV system.
The robotic platform of the AUV system that uses the Sensors and Actuators interfaces defined by AUV_Module.
An interface defined by AUV_Module that provides sensor data to the AUV_Platform.
An interface defined by AUV_Module that provides actuation commands to the AUV_Platform.
A controller within AUV_Module that uses the Inputs interface to receive operational commands.
An interface defined by AUV_Module that provides input events to controllers such as AUV_Operator and LRE_Ctrl.
A controller for the Last Response Engine within AUV_Module that uses both the Inputs and Outputs interfaces.
An interface defined by AUV_Module that provides output events from controllers such as LRE_Ctrl and AUV_Autopilot.
A controller within AUV_Module that uses the Outputs interface to issue autopilot commands.
A primitive type representing natural numbers, defined within AUV_Module.
A primitive type representing integer numbers, defined within AUV_Module.
A primitive type representing string values, defined within AUV_Module.
A primitive type representing boolean values, defined within AUV_Module.
A primitive type representing real numbers, defined within AUV_Module.
A composite type representing a Spherical Vector, containing fields radial, polar, and azimuth all of type real.
A field of the SVec composite type representing the radial component, of type real.
A field of the SVec composite type representing the polar component, of type real.
A field of the SVec composite type representing the azimuth component, of type real.
A composite type representing an obstacle, containing fields ns_rel_dist, ew_rel_dist, depth, id, and obs_hdng.
A field of the Obstacle composite type representing the north-south relative distance, of type real.
A field of the Obstacle composite type representing the east-west relative distance, of type real.
A field of the Obstacle composite type representing the depth of the obstacle, of type real.
A field of the Obstacle composite type representing the identifier of the obstacle, of type real.
A field of the Obstacle composite type representing the heading of the obstacle, of type SVec.
A value in the Sensors interface representing the heading of the AUV, of type SVec.
A value in the Sensors interface representing an obstacle detected by the AUV, of type Obstacle.
An interface defined by AUV_Module that exposes input events such as endTask, reqOCM, reqMOM, reqHCM, reqVel, and reqHdng.
An event in the Intpus interface that signals the end of a task, with no parameters and no return value.
An event in the Intpus interface that requests an OCM operation, with no parameters and no return value.
An event in the Intpus interface that requests a MOM operation, with no parameters and no return value.
An event in the Intpus interface that requests an HCM operation, with no parameters and no return value.
An event in the Intpus interface that requests the current velocity, with no parameters and a return value of type real.
An event in the Intpus interface that requests the current heading, with no parameters and a return value of type real.
An event in the Outputs interface that advises a velocity, taking one parameter of type real and no return value.
An event in the Outputs interface that advises a heading, taking one parameter of type real and no return value.
A composite type representing closeness data, containing fields horiz_cda (real), vert_cda (real), and id (nat).
A field of the Close composite type representing the horizontal closest distance of approach, of type real.
A field of the Close composite type representing the vertical closest distance of approach, of type real.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the distance from the AUV to the obstacle as a real value.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the horizontal distance from the AUV to the obstacle as a real value.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the vertical distance from the AUV to the obstacle as a real value.
